```swift import SwiftUI import HealthKit import HealthKitUI import os let healthDataTypes: Set = [ HKQuantityType.workoutType(), HKQuantityType(.heartRate), HKQuantityType(.activeEnergyBurned), HKQuantityType(.basalEnergyBurned), HKQuantityType(.distanceWalkingRunning), HKQuantityType(.stepCount) ] private let logger = Logger(subsystem: "example.com.MyWorkoutApp", category: "iOS App") @main struct MyApp: App { @State private var accessRequested = false @State private var trigger = false let store = HKHealthStore() var body: some Scene { WindowGroup { ContentView(enabled: $accessRequested) .healthDataAccessRequest(store: store, readTypes: healthDataTypes, trigger: trigger) { result in switch result { case .success(_): accessRequested = true case .failure(let error): // Handle the error here. fatalError("*** An error occurred while requesting authentication: \(error) ***") } logger.debug("Authorization request complete.") } .onAppear() { trigger.toggle() } } } } ```
